title: Rehabilitation / Reconstruction / Upgrading of Damaged Paved Roads, Manila North RD, Province of Pampanga
description: ASSET PRESERVATION PROGRAM - REHABILITATION / RECONSTRUCTION / UPGRADING OF DAMAGED PAVED ROADS - PRIMARY ROADS, MANILA NORTH RD - K0064+357 - K0064+900, PROVINCE OF PAMPANGA
colour_meaning: Look first: an official warning record, or two signs of risk together.

reasons.title: Price per km above 95% of similar works
reasons.detail: Official budget ₱123.8M per km; the 95th percentile of similar works (Road rehabilitation / reconstruction, 214 past contracts) is ₱122.6M per km. Length read from the title: 543 m.
reasons.evidence: In past DPWH road contracts this was linked to about 2.2 times the odds of termination.
checks: Check the stated length against the plans or Bill of Quantities; a wrong length distorts price per km.
Look for items that raise cost but are not road surface: drainage, slope protection, bridges, lighting.
Compare unit prices for the main items (concrete, asphalt) with similar contracts nearby.

reasons.title: A bidder had a contract terminated before
reasons.detail: G.D.L. Construction: 1 of 71 earlier road contracts terminated
reasons.evidence: In past contracts, a winner with an earlier termination had about 2.1 times the odds of another; this held on 2023–2025 data.
checks: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.

claude_note:
**Claude check (advice only):** The ABC of about 67.2M and the 543 m length match the official DPWH record, and the cost per km is only just above the comparison threshold; check the scope of the concrete works first.
**Sources:** confirmed on DPWH API (ABC and stationing match; PhilGEPS notice not attached) · **Suggested next step:** check the source by hand
